* Policy literature: mitigation requires integrated energy, industrial, fiscal, trade measures; economic-growth quality outweighs aggregate GDP alone.
- Literature underscores decoupling, clean-energy investment, emissions trading, efficiency standards, innovation incentives, sustainable-expansion pathways.
